name: Optimals Quick Lift Gummies [10-Pack] | 50mg
description:
Per Package: 50mg THC, 50mg CBG, 50mg THCV 

Per Piece: 5mg THC, 5mg CBG, 5mg THCV 

Enhance any moment with these mood-boosting gummies. Their fast-acting blend of the cannabinoids THC, CBG and THCV – plus 30+ Sativa-leaning terpenes – has been formulated to lift your spirits and help you tune into all of life's little pleasures. They have a 5-15 minute onset and 2-4 hour duration. And like all Wana edibles, they're vegan, naturally melt-proof, and made with organic sweeteners.
